We need for each agent with runs before 2026-10-28, percentage of those runs completed. Assume completed means status = 'completed' maybe. Use runs.created_at < '2026-10-28'. Compute total runs and completed runs per agent, then percentage.

SQL: join runs to agents, filter runs.created_at < date, group by agent id, name. Compute count(*) total, sum(case when status='completed' then 1 else 0 end) as completed, percentage = completed*100.0/total.

{"sql":"SELECT a.id AS agent_id, a.name, COUNT(r.id) AS total_runs,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_runs,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(r.id),0), 2) AS percent_completed
FROM agents a
JOIN runs r ON r.agent_id = a.id
WHERE r.created_at < TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE '2026-10-28 00:00:00+00'

HAVING COUNT(r.id) > 0

function.name: query_database

args.sql:
SELECT a.id AS agent_id, a.name, COUNT(r.id) AS total_runs,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_runs,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(r.id),0), 2) AS percent_completed
FROM agents a
JOIN runs r ON r.agent_id = a.id
WHERE r.created_at < TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE '2026-10-28 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY a.id, a.name
HAVING COUNT(r.id) > 0
ORDER BY a.name;
